people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: Jesus answered them, “This is the work of God, that you believe in him whom he has sent.”
translations.bsb: Jesus replied, “The work of God is this: to believe in the One He has sent.”
translations.kjv: Jesus answered and said unto them, This is the work of God, that ye believe on him whom he hath sent.
translations.asv: Jesus answered and said unto them, This is the work of God, that ye believe on him whom he hath sent.
